name: Baked falafel pita wrap

steps.text: Make the baked falafel in advance, or reheat patties you already have in a 180°C oven for 8 minutes.
steps.cue: The patties are hot through with crisp edges.
steps.tip: Space them out on the tray so they crisp instead of steaming.

steps.text: Warm the pita in a dry pan for 30 seconds a side.
steps.cue: The pita is soft and slightly puffed, not crisp.

steps.text: Spread hummus inside, add falafel, lettuce, cucumber and tomato, then finish with yoghurt dressing.

storage: Store the baked falafel separately for up to 3 days and reheat in a 180°C oven for 8 minutes. Assemble the wrap fresh so the pita stays soft.
